spans.s:
जष r. 1st cl. (जषति-ते) To kill, to wound, to hurt or injure. भ्वा-उभ-सक-
सेट् ।

जस (इर उ) इर् जसु r. 4th cl. (जस्यति) To liberate, to set free, to let loose.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (जसति, जासयति-ते)
 1. To kill or injure.
 2. To
slight or disregard, to treat irreverently.
 3. To strike, to punish
with blows. (इ) जसि r. 1st and 10th cls. (जंसति जंसयति-ते) To pre-
serve, to protect. मोक्षणे दिवा-पर-सक-सेट् । गतौ भ्वा-पर-सक-सेट् ।
बधे अनादरे च चुरा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।

जसुरि m. (-रिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt.
 E. जस् to kill or hurt, Uṇādi
affix उरिन्.

जाषक n. (-कं) A yellow fragrant wood.
 E. जष् to hurt, affix ण्वुल्.
